# Office Image Extractor v1.1.1

## 変更点

- Officeファイルの読み込み後、ドロップエリアをコンパクトなファイル追加欄に切り替えます。
- 選択枚数とZIP保存をまとめ、絞り込み・並べ替え・同一画像の表示は折りたたみに整理しました。
- スマートフォンでは「完全ローカル処理」のバッジを非表示にしました。ファイルのローカル処理自体に変更はありません。
- SVG画像のサムネイルと拡大プレビューに対応しました。スクリプト・外部参照などを含むSVGはプレビューせず、元画像の保存は引き続き可能です。

## Changes

- Compact the Office file drop area after importing documents.
- Put selection totals and ZIP download together; move advanced filters, sorting, and duplicate-image grouping into a disclosure.
- Hide the fully local processing badge on mobile without changing the app's privacy behavior.
- Preview safe SVG images as thumbnails and enlarged images. Reject SVG previews containing scripts, external resources, or other active content while preserving original bytes for download.

## Downloads

- `htmlapps-office-image-extractor-v1.1.1.html` — readable standalone HTML.
- `htmlapps-office-image-extractor-v1.1.1.self-extract.html` — compressed self-extracting standalone HTML.
- `htmlapps-office-image-extractor-v1.1.1.zip` — both standalone versions, manifests, README (Japanese and English), notices, and license.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` — SHA-256 hashes for these three downloads.

These are offline-capable, self-contained HTML files. The app does not upload selected Office documents or make runtime network requests. SVG preview is limited to 16 MiB of original bytes, and some SVGs cannot be previewed for safety. Original image exports are not modified.

See [README (English)](https://github.com/ttomohisa/htmlapps-office-image-extractor/blob/v1.1.1/README.md), [README (日本語)](https://github.com/ttomohisa/htmlapps-office-image-extractor/blob/v1.1.1/README.ja.md) and [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/ttomohisa/htmlapps-office-image-extractor/blob/v1.1.1/CHANGELOG.md).
